paragraphs: Rabbi Yonatan ben Akhinai. (Of the first generation of the amoraim of the Land of Israel.)

[Shabbat 49a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.49a.13-14) relates: Rabbi Yonatan ben Akhinai and Rabbi Yonatan ben Elazar were sitting, with Rabbi Ḥanina bar Ḥama sitting beside them, and a question arose. Rabbi Yonatan ben Elazar said to him … Rabbi Ḥanina bar Ḥama quoted Rabbi Yishmael son of Rabbi Yosi … They were again sitting, and a question arose. Rabbi Ḥanina bar Ḥama said to him … Rabbi Yonatan ben Elazar quoted Rabbi Shimon son of Rabbi Yosi ben Lakunya.[^1]

notes.text: The first linked passage is about moving hides on Shabbat. The [second discussion](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.49b.6-7) asks what the thirty-nine labors correspond to. Hyman abbreviates both exchanges. The linked Bavli has the sages addressing the group, followed by the named reports.
